dynamic_line.gendered_line: A young mother.  I know she was a mother, because I delivered her baby.  Sweet girl, she… she had a good sense of humor.  She came in, spitting that black goo, fighting the orderlies, dead from a bullet wound through the chest.  That's when I… I don't know if I woke up, finally, or if I finally went crazy.  Either way, I broke.  I broke a lot earlier than my colleagues, and that's the only reason I lived.  I skipped out, went to a dead corner of the hospital I used to hide in when I was a resident.  An old stairwell leading to a closed-off unit the maintenance staff were using to store old equipment.  I hid there for hours, while I listened to the world crumbling outside and inside.

responses.text: How did you get out of there?
